Both the build and the verification script pass.

**Root cause:** `resolveRelease` in `packages/shared/config.js:13-16` merged config layers with a single flat `Object.assign`, which shallow-overwrites nested objects. Any package overriding just one key of `output` or `sourcemap` (e.g. `@acme/api` setting only `output.format`) blew away the rest of that nested object, so `output.dir` came out `undefined` and the bundle stage aborted with `EBUNDLE07 config-incomplete`.

**Fix:** merge the `output` and `sourcemap` sub-objects independently (defaults → package overrides → CLI flags) instead of relying on the top-level shallow merge, in `packages/shared/config.js`. `build.js` now finishes with `0 errors`, and `verify.js` confirms the layering rule holds even for override shapes the fixture doesn't ship (e.g. a CLI-level partial `output.dir`).
